changes.freeze: Cannot be refreshed while frozen. Shared immunity after thawing: 0.75 s regular enemies, 1.8 s bosses. Boss freeze still capped at 0.35 s.
changes.slow: Movement only; attack cooldowns and warnings retain their cadence. Boss movement slow capped at 35%.
changes.packs: 4/5/6 complementary enemies on floors 1/5/9, clustered within the warden aura. New generated floors only.
changes.enemies: Ghoul HP 26->72, speed 170->190, damage 7->12. Sorcerer HP 43->90, speed 72->100, damage 12->14. Skeleton speed 105->140, damage 9->12. Archer speed 83->110, damage 8->11. Arrow speed 310->430, caster/imp projectiles 220->330.
changes.xp: Kill XP multiplier rises from 0.45 on floor 1 to 1.0 on floor 11. Existing XP and skills are preserved.

limits: 89 automated scenarios, not a human playtest or a complete 13-floor campaign.
Automatic aiming; simple wall-aware kiting. No invulnerability, gear, potions or free mana. Boss duels use an open arena.
Enemy timing depends partly on runtime instance IDs; combat counts are observations, not deterministic pass thresholds.
Campaign XP reachability checked across 20 seeds without optional trials; this is not a full combat-clearance test.
Existing floor geometry, enemy counts and stored health are preserved. New formations apply on newly generated floors.
No executable export or Windows execution.
Unrelated fog/ambience work was present during native captures and remains outside this change.
